id.description: Job id, e.g. 'nightly-security'. Letters, digits and hyphens.

cron.description: 5-field cron, e.g. "0 3 * * *" for every day at 03:00.

tool.description: Auditor to run — one of the schedulable tools listed above.

devices.description: Device names, or 'all' (the default) for every configured device.

notify_on.description: Which deltas raise an alert. Default: new + worsened.

retain_days.description: How long run history is kept. Default 90.
